item.title: 50th Anniversary Celebration a Success
item.description: The celebration on Thursday 1 October in the L5 breakout space was a success. Thanks to everyone who attended, and to Gloria, Rebecca, Karishma, Matt and the Marketing Team for putting it together.

item.title: Custody Transition Complete: JP Morgan to Northern Trust
item.description: Our master custody arrangements moved to Northern Trust last week, transferring billions in assets. Thank you to Michelle Tassell, Jesse Jury, Ian Wallace, Steve Greenough and all involved.

item.title: NRL Grand Final: Roosters Edge Knights 19-18
item.description: Newcastle, last year's wooden spooners, led 12-6 at half-time. The Roosters dominated the second half, kicked a field goal and held off a late surge to win by a point.

item.title: October is ADHD Awareness Month
item.description: ADHD affects children and adults and is often misunderstood. It can affect attention and self-regulation, and symptoms differ for each person. Visit ADHD Australia for more information.
